items.prompt: White to move. Black has just played d7-d5. Capture en passant.

claims.statement: The en passant capture e5-d6 is legal.

hints: En passant is a pawn capture that is only available on the very next move after an enemy pawn moved two squares forward.
The capturing pawn must stand on the same rank as the pawn that just moved, directly beside it.
The capturing pawn moves diagonally to the square the enemy pawn skipped over, and the enemy pawn is removed.
items.explain: The pawn on e5 captures en passant by moving to d6, the square the enemy pawn passed over; the enemy pawn is removed from the board.
